Job Summary

Join the Observability Platform team to build the ingestion pipeline that handles millions of metrics per second.

You will work alongside full time engineers on production systems from your first week.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design and ship services in Go and Rust.
  • Improve query latency for the metrics store.
  • Write tests, dashboards, and runbooks for what you build.

Required Skills

Strong programming fundamentals in at least one systems language. Experience with distributed systems is an asset. Familiarity with Linux, SQL, and version control is expected.
